name: Debt
text: Local Action: Test Influence. If you pass, discard this card. Reckoning: Some men have come to collect on your debt. Flip this card.

action.text: Settle your Debt: test Influence. If you pass, discard Debt.

pass.text: Your contacts pay off the creditors.

fail.text: The creditors refuse to wait much longer.

backs.text: Thugs corner you in an alley to collect! Lose 2 Health.
They seize your equipment as collateral! Discard 1 Item possession or lose 2 Sanity.

name: Dark Pact
text: Reckoning: Roll 1 die. On a 1, it is time to fulfil your part of the bargain; flip this card.

outcomes.text: The shadows wait a little longer.

backs.text: Darkness claims its price from the world! Advance Doom by 1 and lose 2 Sanity.
Hounds from beyond the veil drag you into the dark! You are devoured!

name: Detained
text: You cannot move or perform actions other than the action on this card. Instead of resolving an encounter, flip this card. Local Action: Test Influence. If you pass, discard this card.

action.text: Talk or slip your way out: test Influence to discard Detained.

pass.text: The guards unlock the cell door.

backs.text: You are released after questioning, though your nerves are frayed. Become Delayed.
A sympathetic magistrate drops the charges and returns a piece of evidence. Gain 1 Clue.

name: Amnesia
text: When you perform a Rest action, you may roll 1 die. On a 5 or 6, discard this card. Reckoning: Test Will. If you fail, flip this card.

backs.text: Forgotten Crimes: Evidence surfaces that you went on a crime spree during your blackout! Gain Detained.
Sudden Clarity: Your memories rush back all at once! Gain 2 Clues and lose 1 Sanity.

name: Paranoia
text: When you perform a Rest action, you may roll 1 die. On a 5 or 6, discard this card. Reckoning: Test Will. If you fail, flip this card.

backs.text: You barricade your door and refuse to come out! Lose 1 Sanity and become Delayed.
Someone really was following you! A Cultist ambushes you!

name: Hallucinations
text: When you perform a Rest action, you may roll 1 die. On a 5 or 6, discard this card. Reckoning: Test Will. If you fail, flip this card.

action.text: Ground yourself: test Will to discard Hallucinations.

backs.text: You fire wildly at phantoms in the dark! Lose 2 Sanity.
The visions part to reveal a real truth. Gain 1 Clue.

name: Leg Injury
text: When you perform a Rest action, you may roll 1 die. On a 5 or 6, discard this card. Reckoning: Test Strength. If you fail, flip this card.

backs.text: Your leg gives out on the road! Lose 1 Health and become Delayed.
With rest and splints, the bone sets cleanly.

name: Back Injury
text: When you perform a Rest action, you may roll 1 die. On a 5 or 6, discard this card. Reckoning: Test Strength. If you fail, flip this card.

backs.text: A sharp spasm leaves you gasping! Lose 2 Health.
The pain subsides at last.

name: Internal Injury
text: When you perform a Rest action, you may roll 1 die. On a 5 or 6, discard this card. Reckoning: Test Strength. If you fail, flip this card.

action.text: Seek treatment: test Strength to discard Internal Injury.

backs.text: The bleeding worsens! Lose 2 Health.
The crisis passes and you begin to mend.

name: Blessed
text: 4, 5, and 6's count as successes on your tests. If you would gain another Blessed Condition, flip this card instead. If you would gain a Cursed Condition, discard this card instead. Reckoning: Roll 1 die. On a 1 or 2, discard this card.

backs.text: The grace that protected you departs, leaving you at peace.

name: Cursed
text: Only 6's count as successes on your tests. If you would gain another Cursed Condition, flip this card instead. If you would gain a Blessed Condition, discard this card instead. Reckoning: Roll 1 die. On a 4, 5, or 6, discard this card.

outcomes.text: The curse still clings to you.

backs.text: The shadow lifts from your fate.
